newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Piston forms car parts venture in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Nippon Piston forms car parts venture in U.S..

text.p: Nippon Piston Ring Co Ltd said on Thursday that it had set up a joint venture in the United States with Weyburn-Bartel Inc to produce camshafts.
The venture, Weyburn Assembled Camshafts Inc, will provide powder-metal camshafts to Chrysler Corp from 1998, Nippon Piston said in a statement.
Powder metal camshafts are lighter than cast-iron ones, it said.
The venture, capitalised at $3 million and located in Michigan, is 80 percent owned by Weyburn-Bartel and 20 percent by Nippon Piston, it said.
They plan to invest a total of about $20 million in the venture over the next five years, Nippon Piston said.
Nippon Piston currently supplies its Japanese-made powder-metal camshafts to Ford Motor Co.
